correctness.rationale: Neumann symmetric and Dirichlet antisymmetric edge modes give K_ij=δ_ij g_t(x-y)+(2/m-δ_ij)g_t(x+y). Differentiate Gaussian to obtain q(z)=(z²-2)e^{-z²/4}/(8√π), scale x,y by √t, and integrate absolute kernel row: F_m(x) exactly. Symmetry gives same L1 norm. For m=2, partition of the real line yields C2=√(2/π)e^-1/2. With α=1-2/m, |a-αb|+(1+α)|b| increases strictly wherever ab<0; a=q(x-y),b=q(x+y) have an open sign-opposite y-interval for every x>0. Uniform gap ≤2C2/m gives interior maxima, compactness and monotonic constants. The difference quotient D_m(x) converges even at moving maximizing positions by dominated convergence on a compact set; optimization yields C∞-C_m=κ/m+o(1/m), κ>0. Independent Gaussian quadrature at x=0,.25,1.45,4 and m=2,3,4,8,∞ verifies monotone sample (F∞(1.45)≈0.71492), not global maximization.
